deep_analysis:
MARKET: BTC holds above continuum EMA300 (~80777) for 154min, Wyckoff MARKUP, trend_quality STRONG_UP, aggregate 90L/3S LONG_BIAS. Sources agree (15m regime LONG_BIAS, continuum ABOVE, auto-trader's own chop detector says CHOP — shadow only, 28.6% WR n=21, no action). Regime flips/24h: aggregate 22, BTC 13 — p75/p50 standing state, not anomalous. LONGs are the right side of this tape.

OPEN BOOK: 2 bb-squeeze+ longs, both regime-aligned, both ~35min old, both flat (+0.05% CAKE, +0.21% DOGE). Neither thesis broken. DOGE entered at meta_rsi 68.4 (top of band — high-entry long; 65+ longs are +0.15 / 59%WR over 7d so not a kill, but not a template to size up). CAKE at meta_rsi 62.1 sits in the 55-64 mid band (7d: 20T, 45%WR, -$0.39) — historically the bleed band — but mid-band blocks are measured-refuted and advisory-only, no steer issued on that basis. bb-squeeze+ itself is healthy: 14d 22T 68.2%WR +$0.67, trail-activated 18/22, avg MFE 0.82%.

24H SCORECARD: 25T, 48%WR, -$0.89. Winners are the trail family doing its job — KAS/TURBO/GOAT/MINA/ICP bb-squeeze+ longs all +1.1 to +1.5% via profit-monster-trail. Losers are the wrong side: HBAR SHORT volume-buildup- at meta_rsi 38.5 (-5.25%, shorting oversold inside a bull tape — winning side was LONG), BABY SHORT -5.34% (MAE 1.98% = squeezed), DOT SHORT -5.65%, FOGO SHORT -3.53%. Four of the five biggest 24h bleeds are volume-buildup- shorts fighting aggregate LONG_BIAS.

CHOP-BLEED KPI (dollar share, 7d): 91.4% (44 arm-losers of 51 losers; -$ loss from never-armed vs total loss), null_mfe=1, vs baseline 84.1%. Same-day arm rate 16.0% official (4/25) with 8 NULL mfe_pct (arm_of_nonnull 23.5%) — self-healing via nightly backfill, quoted with NULL count per #194. 7d LONG arm rate 48.7% (76T) — below the 50% tripwire. Reading: entry quality is deteriorating; the bleed is entries that never reach +0.40%, not exits giving back armed profit. Route is entry-quality work (brain_auditor), not trail/UGB tweaks. Two measures stated: dollar share 91.4% is NOT count share (44/51=86.3%).
regime_context: LONG_BIAS (aggregate 90L/3S, 15m regime LONG_BIAS, continuum ABOVE EMA300 154min, linreg LEAN_BULL, Wyckoff MARKUP, CALM). BTC 4h NEUTRAL. Auto-trader shadow labels CHOP — disagreeing source, shadow-only stats negative, no conflict with live longs. Direction-flavored steers below carry condition=retest next cycle; flips/24h 22agg/13btc is normal churn, a true <6 flip tape has not occurred since Oct 2. Both open longs are aligned; no short-bias steer is warranted while 1m holds above EMA300.
